paper.title: The Bullet Cluster Under EFC: Confronting Entropy-Gradient Gravity with JWST-Era Mass Reconstructions

efc_mechanisms.name: Density Saturation Theta(rho)
efc_mechanisms.role: Suppresses EFC corrections in high-density regimes (rho >> rho_crit), recovers GR in Solar System + stellar interiors

efc_mechanisms.name: Regime-dependent gravitational modification
efc_mechanisms.role: mu < 1 at cosmological linear scales, mu > 1 at non-linear galactic/cluster scales (single variational action)

efc_mechanisms.name: Entropy-gradient lensing
efc_mechanisms.role: Effective lensing potential couples to entropy-flow scalar phi, producing anisotropic response near thermodynamic discontinuities (shock fronts)

external_studies.role: Highest-resolution mass map (JWST NIRCam SL + WL)
JWST/NIRCam + DECam virial masses; 10:1 minor merger

lensing_setup.halo_profile: Pseudo-Isothermal Elliptical Mass Distribution (PIEMD; Kassiola & Kovner 1993, Kneib et al. 1996)

baseline_results.verdict: null hypothesis validated; PIEMD halo geometry produces no shock-front asymmetry

sidm_constraint.efc_interpretation: sigma/m = 0 by construction (no DM particle); tightening consistent with EFC's no-particle ontology but does not prove it

regime_transition_P1.verdict: mu ~ 1.1 enhancement insufficient alone for full cluster mass discrepancy; full quantitative prediction requires EFC field equation solution (planned)
